title: demiurge — Architecture SSOT (JSON tree)
ssot_note: JSON=SSOT (AI/tool parse); humans view ARCHITECTURE.html. Prose mirror = ARCHITECTURE.md. Faithful transcription of ARCHITECTURE.md + README.md + CLAUDE.md + QFORGE/QFORGE.md — no invented nodes/numbers (commons c9).
overview: demiurge is a universal, hexa-native technical-design architecture program: it drives any engineering system through one 7-verb pipeline, with each field plugged in as a manifest-only domain (single generic dispatch, no per-domain code — governance d4). It is the meta-conductor: chip, accelerator, superconductor, spacecraft, and BCI 'desks' all live in one building. Two surfaces sit on the same pipeline: a Next.js web GUI (human surface) and a hexa-native CLI (AI-agent surface). Reusable implementation is owned by the sibling hexa-lang repo — demiurge is a typed-interface consumer, never an absorber (d3).
pipeline_note: One generic 7-verb dispatch (manifest-driven, d4). CLI (cli/) and web GUI (web/) both traverse the same path.

meta_conductor_chain.note: rfc_004 §4 — typed seam contracts between passes. Upstream = hexa-lang (d17).

data_flow: Input = a domain manifest (domains/<DOMAIN>.md) and/or a compute deck (decks/<cell>). Adding/renaming/removing a variant is manifest-only (d4).
Pipeline = the generic 7-verb dispatch, driven from cli/ (CLI surface) or web/ (GUI surface) — both traverse the same path.
Verification = hexa verify gates; a passing result is folded directly into the atlas atom (embedded.gen.hexa, the audit SSOT — no intermediate ledger files, d_atlas_as_audit_ssot).
Output = records under exports/ / .verdicts/; a terminal verified discovery becomes a paper under PAPER(S)/<slug> (gated: terminal verdict + significance).

governance.rule: Implementation lives in one canonical home (hexa-lang); demiurge consumes only.
Single generic dispatch; instances are manifests, never hardcoded names in the generic layer.
Drive every non-wet-lab step to completed-form; absorbed=true ⇔ all non-wet-lab gates PASS.
Validated decks fire compute campaigns autonomously (no user gate on cost-bearing rent).
Web-GUI deploy stays user-approval-gated; compute autonomy unaffected.
Parallel-first; GRID-parallel compute to the walltime floor.
First-principles physics breaks the ML training-distribution wall; never force a target number / present under-converged value (honest).

b_dfpt_lambda_tc.title: (b) DFPT λ/Tc promotion of the flat-band winners — the 'flat-band → anomalous λ?' test
b_dfpt_lambda_tc.in_flight: LaOs3Si2 DFPT (summer FREE pool, same 2x2x2 q / 16^3 k for head-to-head) — STILL PENDING (numbers not yet harvested, d6).
b_dfpt_lambda_tc.verdict: 🟠 LaRu3Si2 HARVESTED but UNSTABLE at 2x2x2 (lambda/Tc untrustworthy as absolute; physical-bound lambda~1.6 Tc~7K). LaOs3Si2 head-to-head still PENDING. Central question (flat-band -> anomalous lambda?) PARTIALLY answered: large el-ph drive present but coupled to lattice instability; needs denser-q confirmation.
b_dfpt_lambda_tc.LaRu3Si2_result: HARVESTED 2026-06-17 (vast pod 41069486, QE 7.5 ph.x el-ph 'simple', 2x2x2 q, 16^3 k, DOS(Ef)=35.408 states/spin/Ry). 🔴 DYNAMICALLY UNSTABLE: 11 imaginary modes, 6 GENUINE non-Gamma soft modes down to -77 cm-1 (min -77.14 at q=(0,0,-0.800)) -> absolute lambda/Tc UNTRUSTWORTHY (d6 gate). NAIVE (lambda.x convention, all modes) lambda=-0.34/Tc=0 (imaginary modes contribute -1.98). PHYSICAL (imaginary dropped) lambda=1.64, omega_log=56.3 K, Tc(mu*0.10)=6.96K, Tc(mu*0.13)=6.40K — matches measured 7K but discards 11 modes (soft UPPER BOUND, NOT converged).
b_dfpt_lambda_tc.flat_band_answer: PARTIAL/HONEST (c9/d6): physical-only lambda=1.64 IS strong-coupling (large flat-band N(Ef)=35.4 boost) AND its Tc~7K matches the real material, suggesting the flat band DOES drive a large el-ph — but the SAME softness destabilizes the kagome lattice on the coarse 2x2x2 q-grid, so the clean 'flat-band -> anomalously high lambda' claim is NOT yet established. Soft modes are likely grid-aliasing (common for kagome metals on coarse q).
b_dfpt_lambda_tc.breakthrough_path: (d2) 4x4x4 q-grid DFPT to decide: soft modes HARDEN (artifact -> trust lambda~1.6, flat-band confirmed as lambda booster) vs PERSIST (real CDW instability). QFORGE cross-val deferred (assembling corrupted unstable data adds no info).

MATH-SPECTRA.name: MATH-SPECTRA — '스펙트럼 탐정' pure-math exploration (parallel track)
MATH-SPECTRA.question: Where does arithmetic live in spectra? (Riemann ζ zeros ↔ random-matrix GUE ↔ flat-band adjacency spectra / Hilbert-Pólya)

findings.negative_1: probe1 ζ↔lattice bridge FALSIFIED 🔴: ζ zeros = GUE (quantum-chaotic) vs lattice dispersive = Poisson (integrable) + flat band = macroscopic δ level. Naive 'RH zeros == flat-band lattice spectrum' is FALSE.
findings.negative_2: probe2/3 flat-band CLS multiplicities = elementary polynomials in L (closed-form theorem VERIFIED) with at most a BOUNDED gcd(L,q) commensurability offset → no deep arithmetic in CLS counts.
findings.positive_4: probe4 🟢 CONFIRMED: Fibonacci-chain gap IDOS pinned to module Z+Zα (α=1/φ); 8/8 major gaps match small-|n| gap-labeling integer, n·α beats best rational in 8/8.
findings.positive_5: probe5 🟢 CONFIRMED: arithmetic is SUBSTITUTION-SPECIFIC, set by the Perron letter frequency — silver-mean→Z+Z/√2, period-doubling→dyadic, Thue-Morse→non-single-module. Not generic aperiodicity.
findings.open_6: probe6 2D Ammann-Beenker 🟠 INCONCLUSIVE (finite 953-vertex patch did not resolve clean major gaps above finite-size spacing; construction sound).

MATH-SPECTRA.scope: 1D arc fully charted (ζ↔lattice bridge falsified; flat-band CLS=bounded gcd; quasicrystal gap-labeling=Perron modules); 2D patch-limited. Numerical verification, not proof (c9).
